# Three.js

`three.module.min.js` is the unmodified ES module build of **three@0.170.0**, downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.min.js.

Used only by the lazy-loaded agent workshop. It is served locally, with no third-party runtime requests. The upstream MIT license is included in `three-LICENSE.txt`.
